statistic: fixed-target pooled slope of the expected-error excess of projection over single-scale ranking on log10 lever arm, points per decade; slices (target, rung count) with at least 3 windows; leave-one-recipe-out jackknife SE
targets: sizes at or above 150M with at least 5 sizes below (150M and 300M); a target is admitted when at least half its recipe pairs are determined by its own three-seed evidence

secondary.assumption: the predicted magnitude assumes the new recipes resemble DataDecide's 25 (drawn from the same distribution of power-law parameters and recipe-specific misfit); it is not part of the pass criterion
secondary.source: results/replication/protocol_dry_run.json: the corrected recipe model at multiplier 1 on the exact 6ND grid, 150 worlds

analysis_entry_point: scripts/analyze_replication.py (refuses to run if the pinned SHA-256 of the frozen modules differs)

within_regime_secondary.reason: PREDICTIONS_TASK_CONFIG_STEPS.md found that config steps do not contribute (outcome O1; step-term share interval includes zero), so the conditional secondary is not added; it would not be estimable on this ladder anyway (2 within-regime windows per target, below the 3-window slice rule)

evaluation_set.definition: DataDecide's in-loop c4_en-validation file (sha256 c37d6b11...), 2,099 documents by id and text hash
evaluation_set.decontamination: scripts/decontaminate.py removes training documents whose NFC text hash matches the evaluation set

numerical_stability_diagnostic.inputs: every bpb value and each size's compute
numerical_stability_diagnostic.reported: slope min, max, SD, largest deviation from the reported slope, and the number of draws whose verdict differs
numerical_stability_diagnostic.role: output only; the verdict rule is unchanged and uses the unperturbed inputs
